gaps: The retrieved water-manager disagreement is retained as a governance mediator, without labelling it armed violence or constructing an unsupported full FCV chain.
Subnational depth is limited to sparse Malabo/Bata station comparisons; comparable recent municipality-level exposure and vulnerability evidence remains a material gap.
The October 2026 NDC 3.0 could not be read directly; the 2022 NDC is retained only as historical policy context, not current commitments.

executive_assessment.text: Historical station evidence distinguishes Malabo and Bata but is too sparse for national or municipality-wide climate inference.
Water coordination, meteorological capacity and forest benefit-sharing are documented governance concerns. Administrative disagreement does not establish climate-driven armed violence.
